title: The full critical XY spin-field limit with fixed boundary
exact_target: For the fixed-boundary critical nearest-neighbor XY model in an admissible planar domain, does its normalized complex spin distribution converge along the entire mesh sequence in $H^{-3}_loc$ to the specified critical vertex field $V_*$? Require convergence of every finite collection of smooth compactly supported smearings, their conjugates, and all mixed nonnegative integer moments.
